title: EvidenceSidecar
description: Written by mvt-runner next to each backup's canonical manifest (EPOCH-401). content_root is the evidence identity that EPOCH-402 keys evidence_items on. Zod mirror: ts/evidenceSidecar.ts.

evidence_name.description: Backup directory name as discovered by mvt-runner.

content_root.description: sha256 of the exact canonical manifest bytes. Verify with: sha256sum <manifest_path>.

manifest_path.description: Content-addressed manifest location relative to the workspace, '/'-separated: hashes/<evidence_name>.<content_root>.sha256.

source_path.description: Absolute path of the hashed backup at hashing time. Informational: identity is content_root, not location.
